fixed_tensor_unit.meaning: K bounds all fixed integer ranks, role/round/operation inventories after chronological tensor product, charged target completion and paid splitting. No owned array is a productive role.

finite_compiler_count_bound.bounds: A(n) bounds productive roles, paid leaves, compiled unit instances, primitive/route descriptors, owned banks, and coefficient-construction descriptions. Allocate2 banks for EVERY unit instance; C_N<=2*A(N). A(n) is a concrete finite recursive integer, not expanded or assumed small.
finite_compiler_count_bound.replication: At n, the denominator-clearer product of smaller widths is <=A(n-1)^(n-1); source/exit flow inventories are <=J(n). The displayed recurrence dominates their products, smaller-program inlining and two owned banks per unit.

rational_height_and_prime.meaning: Each exact rational arithmetic operation increases numerator/denominator bit height by at most4*(height+1). This includes fixed rational matchers/Gaussian eliminations, not only VALUE coefficients. Every fixed matrix/witness is compiled first.
rational_height_and_prime.choose_q: An odd prime q>max(2^45*N^5, 2^(2*H)), excluding the finite completed-program witnesses. No previous numerical prime/H/precision threshold is reused.

all_in_primitive_fee.single_fixed_route_or_leaf_normalizer_bo: (q+2)^(16*(N+1)^2) retained primitive invocations, including low-type dispatch, carry and polynomially many fixed affine/scaling/old-atom operations. Rank-one leaf shears<=4*N^2-2*N; bad classes charged<=32*N^2 ordinary calls separately in moment.
all_in_primitive_fee.actual_cost: F times a positive maximum retained completed-backend/stream primitive constant. The latter is fixed at each finite level, never declared1 or free. This is a constructive finite bound schema, not a materialized all-in machine constant.
all_in_primitive_fee.parking: At most4*(B_N+C_N) FIELD passes per query plus initialization/teardown. B_N, P_N, C_N and all route counts are bounded above by the explicit A(N) expressions. The F bound dominates these positive products.

stock.nested_backend: Each completed finite backend restores all outer ROW/spectators and its own stock before return; it supplies no externally assumed empty space.

eventual_threshold_rule.stage_constant: K_j>=16 times the sum of F*all positive inherited primitive constants, reserve/adapter bounds and the already frozen backend constant globalized to ALL widths by its finite fallback. K_j is newly fixed before e varies.
eventual_threshold_rule.sufficient_form: A new integer e_j dominates E_backend^(ceil(2/rho)), the borrow threshold, and ceil((32*K_j/eta_j)^(ceil(8/eta_j)))+2^(ceil(8/eta_j)).
eventual_threshold_rule.justification: For fixed positive eta, loge<=2/eta * e^(eta/2); the displayed oversized threshold absorbs every fixed coefficient in the three root costs and k<e/2. Backend subcalls below their own threshold use the completed all-width finite fallback. Bounded smaller outer inputs use the already completed backend.
eventual_threshold_rule.not_claimed: No explicit decimal e_j, final uniform WORD, q or fixed machine execution is materialized. Exponent remains conditional on the same retained native/compiler/tape contracts.
